title: Info Security Analyst Entry Level - Vulnerability Assessment

cond_0001.intro:
Vulnerability Information Security Analysts are on the cutting edge of assuring the security of [Company name masked] and its members. The candidate selected for this position will join an innovative team that conducts risk and vulnerability assessments across a [Company name masked] enterprise that spans the entire globe. They will provide support to information security personnel in the research and investigation of new and emerging risks while also assessing those risks against production environments of more than 300,000 assets. This position sits on the frontline of the safety and security of [Company name masked] member data.
Within defined guidelines and framework investigates, analyzes, and responds to security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches) within [Company name masked]'s environments using a variety of cyber defense tools to detect and respond to threats. Conducts vulnerability, security configuration, and/or penetration testing assessments of systems and networks. Identifies cyber threats, analyzes operational impacts, and communicates to appropriate collaborators. Stays ahead of the latest information security threats, exploits, trends, and intelligence.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Assists in monitoring internal and external networks, systems, and applications for security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches). Responds to cyber incidents, performing routine analysis using security tools. Assists in using the discoveries from the incident response process to make basic improvements to the existing detection capabilities. Details findings to security alerts. Works under supervision and with some assistance, resolves issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product. Ensures risks associated with business activities are optimally identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
Up to 2 years of related experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity and/or Information Technology with a security focus to include accountability for simple to moderately complex tasks and/or projects.
Foundational and conceptual knowledge of function/discipline and demonstrated application of knowledge, skills, and abilities towards work products.
Preferred Requirements
Foundational level of business acumen in the areas of business operations, risk management, industry practices and emerging trends.
Experience or knowledge of vulnerability management.
The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

cond_0090.intro:
We are looking for an Entry Level Vulnerability Information Security Analyst to join our team. The candidate selected will work alongside an innovative team that conducts risk and vulnerability assessments across a global enterprise spanning more than 300,000 assets. Together, the team supports information security personnel in researching and investigating new and emerging risks, and assessing those risks against production environments. This position works at the frontline of protecting member data.
Working within defined guidelines and framework, the team investigates, analyzes, and responds to security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches) using a variety of cyber defense tools. The role involves coordinating on vulnerability, security configuration, and/or penetration testing assessments of systems and networks. The team identifies cyber threats, analyzes operational impacts, and communicates findings to appropriate collaborators, while staying current with the latest information security threats, exploits, trends, and intelligence.
cond_0090.responsibilities:
Assist in monitoring internal and external networks, systems, and applications for security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches).
Work alongside colleagues to respond to cyber incidents, performing routine analysis using security tools.
Help apply discoveries from the incident response process to make basic improvements to existing detection capabilities.
Share findings by detailing them in security alerts.
Work under supervision and with assistance to resolve issues and navigate obstacles to deliver work product.
Support efforts to ensure risks associated with business activities are identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0090.requirements:
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
Up to 2 years of related experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity and/or Information Technology with a security focus, including accountability for simple to moderately complex tasks and/or projects.
Foundational and conceptual knowledge of function/discipline and demonstrated application of knowledge, skills, and abilities towards work products.
Foundational level of business acumen in the areas of business operations, risk management, industry practices and emerging trends.
Experience or knowledge of vulnerability management.

The candidate selected will join a team that conducts risk and vulnerability assessments across a global enterprise. They will support information security personnel in researching and investigating new and emerging risks while assessing those risks against production environments of more than 300,000 assets. This position sits on the frontline of the safety and security of member data.
Within defined guidelines and framework investigates, analyzes, and responds to security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches) using a variety of cyber defense tools to detect and respond to threats. Conducts vulnerability, security configuration, and/or penetration testing assessments of systems and networks. Identifies cyber threats, analyzes operational impacts, and communicates to appropriate collaborators. Stays ahead of the latest information security threats, exploits, trends, and intelligence.

Assists in using the discoveries from the incident response process to make basic improvements to the existing detection capabilities. Details findings to security alerts. Works under supervision and with some assistance, resolves issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product. Ensures risks associated with business activities are optimally identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

Bachelor's degree: OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.

Foundational and conceptual knowledge of function/discipline and demonstrated application of knowledge, skills, and abilities towards work products.

The candidate selected will work alongside an innovative team that conducts risk and vulnerability assessments across a global enterprise spanning more than 300,000 assets. Together, the team supports information security personnel in researching and investigating new and emerging risks, and assessing those risks against production environments. This position works at the frontline of protecting member data.
Working within defined guidelines and framework, the team investigates, analyzes, and responds to security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches) using a variety of cyber defense tools. The role involves coordinating on vulnerability, security configuration, and/or penetration testing assessments of systems and networks. The team identifies cyber threats, analyzes operational impacts, and communicates findings to appropriate collaborators, while staying current with the latest information security threats, exploits, trends, and intelligence.
cond_0360.responsibilities:
Assist in monitoring internal and external networks, systems, and applications for security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches).
Work alongside colleagues to respond to cyber incidents, performing routine analysis using security tools.
Help apply discoveries from the incident response process to make basic improvements to existing detection capabilities.
Share findings by detailing them in security alerts.
Work under supervision and with assistance to resolve issues and navigate obstacles to deliver work product.
Support efforts to ensure risks associated with business activities are identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0360.requirements:
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
Up to 2 years of related experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity and/or Information Technology with a security focus, including accountability for simple to moderately complex tasks and/or projects.
Foundational and conceptual knowledge of function/discipline and demonstrated application of knowledge, skills, and abilities towards work products.
Foundational level of business acumen in the areas of business operations, risk management, industry practices and emerging trends.
Experience or knowledge of vulnerability management.
The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

cond_0372.intro:
We are looking for an Entry Level Vulnerability Information Security Analyst to join our team.
Candidates selected for this position will join a team that conducts risk and vulnerability assessments across a global enterprise. They will provide support to information security personnel in the research and investigation of new and emerging risks while also assessing those risks against production environments of more than 300,000 assets. This position sits on the frontline of the safety and security of member data.
Within defined guidelines and framework investigates, analyzes, and responds to security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches) within [Company name masked]'s environments using a variety of cyber defense tools to detect and respond to threats. Conducts vulnerability, security configuration, and/or penetration testing assessments of systems and networks. Identifies cyber threats, analyzes operational impacts, and communicates to appropriate collaborators. Stays ahead of the latest information security threats, exploits, trends, and intelligence.
cond_0372.responsibilities: Assists in monitoring internal and external networks, systems, and applications for security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches). Responds to cyber incidents, performing routine analysis using security tools. Assists in using the discoveries from the incident response process to make basic improvements to the existing detection capabilities. Details findings to security alerts. Works under supervision and with some assistance, resolves issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product. Ensures risks associated with business activities are optimally identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0372.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience; or around 4 years of related experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.
Up to 2 years of experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity and/or Information Technology with a security focus, including exposure to simple to moderately complex tasks and/or projects. Relevant education or training is also considered.
Working knowledge of core concepts within the function/discipline, with some demonstrated application of that knowledge toward work products.
Some background in business operations, risk management, industry practices, and emerging trends is helpful but can be developed on the job.
Some experience with or exposure to vulnerability management is welcome; a willingness to learn in this area is equally valued.
The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

The team identifies cyber threats, analyzes operational impacts, and communicates findings to appropriate collaborators, while staying current with the latest information security threats, exploits, trends, and intelligence.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Assist in monitoring internal and external networks, systems, and applications for security anomalies and events (e.g. Suspicious behavior, attacks, and security breaches).
Work alongside colleagues to respond to cyber incidents, performing routine analysis using security tools.
Help apply discoveries from the incident response process to make basic improvements to existing detection capabilities.
Share findings by detailing them in security alerts.
Work under supervision and with assistance to resolve issues and navigate obstacles to deliver work product.
Support efforts to ensure risks associated with business activities are identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
cond_0648.requirements:
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
Up to 2 years of related experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity and/or Information Technology with a security focus, including accountability for simple to moderately complex tasks and/or projects.
Foundational and conceptual knowledge of function/discipline and demonstrated application of knowledge, skills, and abilities towards work products.
Foundational level of business acumen in the areas of business operations, risk management, industry practices and emerging trends.
Experience or knowledge of vulnerability management.
The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.
